en.hubeali:
From him, from Ubdous Bin Ibrahim al Baghdady, 
(It has been narrated) raising it to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The henna removes the odour, and increases in the water of the face, and aromatises the breath, and improves the birth’.
en.sarwar: 5. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from ‘Ubdus ibn Ibrahim al-Baghdadiy in a marfu‘ manner has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Applying henna dispels bad odor, increases beauty of the face, sweetens the fragrance and beautifies the child.’”
